title: Cannot Connect to Xbox Live
shortDescription: Network connection succeeds but Live services fail.
fullDescription: Error 0x80072EE7 means the Xbox can reach the internet but cannot resolve or reach Xbox Live endpoints. DNS or NAT issues are the typical cause.

fixSteps.title: Set DNS manually
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Network > Advanced > DNS settings > Manual. Primary 8.8.8.8 secondary 1.1.1.1.

fixSteps.title: Open NAT
fixSteps.instruction: Enable UPnP on router or forward Xbox ports.

title: Game License Cannot Be Verified
shortDescription: Xbox cannot verify ownership of a game.
fullDescription: Error 0x803F8001 happens when the console is offline or used as a non-home Xbox for shared content. Set Home Xbox or sign in to verify.

fixSteps.title: Sign in
fixSteps.instruction: Sign in with the account that owns the game.

fixSteps.title: Set Home Xbox
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > Personalization > My home Xbox.

fixSteps.title: Reset licenses
fixSteps.instruction: Online once with the original purchaser account.

title: Sign-In Failed
fullDescription: Error 0x87DD0006 indicates a failed authentication. Common when password recently changed or 2FA timeout.

fixSteps.title: Reset password
fixSteps.instruction: On account.microsoft.com reset password, retry on Xbox.

faq.a: Yes, sign-in needs Xbox Live reachable.

title: Game Update Failed
fullDescription: Error 0xE0E8000F appears during failed updates due to insufficient storage or corrupted patch.

faq.a: Yes, USB 3 drives work for Xbox One games; Series-optimized need expansion card.

title: System Update Error
shortDescription: Xbox stuck in startup with E106.
fullDescription: E106 is a startup error indicating system OS corruption. Offline System Update via USB usually recovers it.

fixSteps.title: OSU1 USB recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Download OSU1.zip from xbox.com, copy to FAT32 USB, plug in, hold pair+eject while powering on.

fixSteps.title: Microsoft service
fixSteps.instruction: If recovery fails, request repair on xbox.com/support.

faq.a: Cloud saves preserved; local saves at risk.

title: System Update Aborted
shortDescription: Update aborted; console reboots to recovery.
fullDescription: E305 occurs when an update is interrupted. Use Reset This Console while keeping games and apps in Troubleshoot menu.

fixSteps.title: Reset keep games
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Pair+Eject+Power; in menu choose Reset and keep games & apps.

fixSteps.title: Full reset
fixSteps.instruction: If above fails, full factory reset.

faq.a: Reset and keep games preserves apps; saves cloud-synced.

title: Series X Won't Read Disc
shortDescription: Console fails to read inserted Blu-ray.
fullDescription: Series X disc drive can fail to read due to dirty laser, scratched disc, or after firmware update affecting drive detection.

fixSteps.title: Clean disc
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe disc with microfiber, center out.

fixSteps.title: Service repair
fixSteps.instruction: If still no read, request Microsoft repair.

videoSearchQuery: Series X disc not reading fix

faq.a: Series S is digital-only, no disc drive.

title: Xbox Wireless Controller Drops
fullDescription: Controller drops can come from low batteries, RF interference, or out-of-date firmware.

fixSteps.title: Fresh batteries
fixSteps.instruction: AA batteries or charge play-and-charge kit.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Connect via USB, Settings > Devices > Controller > Update.

faq.a: Yes, plug into Series X for wired play.

title: Series X Shuts Off From Overheating
fullDescription: Series X has a top exhaust that must be unobstructed. Vertical orientation in tight enclosure causes thermal shutdown.

faq.a: Top vent must remain unobstructed; horizontal works if side cleared.

title: Internal SSD Almost Full
shortDescription: Series X/S internal SSD running out of room.
fullDescription: Series-optimized titles must run from internal SSD or expansion card. External USB drives only run Xbox One games.

fixSteps.title: Manage games
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > Storage > Manage. Uninstall unused.

fixSteps.title: Add expansion card
fixSteps.instruction: Install Seagate or WD Black Series expansion card.

fixSteps.title: External USB
fixSteps.instruction: USB 3 drive for Xbox One titles only.

faq.a: WD Black C50 sometimes cheaper than Seagate.
